findings.title: US multiple-dependency form defect (37 CFR 1.75(c))
findings.attack: 37 CFR 1.75(c) / MPEP 608.01(n) prohibit a multiple dependent claim from serving as a basis for another multiple dependent claim, directly or indirectly. The claim set cascades this violation from claim 13 onward. This is a US-specific formal objection to claim form, not a merits rejection; EPO/UK carry no equivalent prohibition.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Restructure the dependency tree so no MDC's range includes another MDC; see Prompt 37 reply F-37-1 for the mechanism and full claim list.

findings.title: Registered figure/numeral with no corresponding description text
findings.attack: FIG. 13A / numeral 220 is registered in figures.md/registry.md but absent from the description's brief description of drawings and body text; numeral 146, used in claim 1, is never introduced in the description's prose. Both fail the requirement, common to US/EPO/UK practice, that every claim and drawing numeral be supported by description text.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the missing description text for FIG. 13A (or remove it and numeral 220), and add numeral 146 to [0182]; see Prompt 38 reply F-38-3/F-38-5.

findings.title: Non-standard dependent-claim format
findings.attack: Claims 47, 61, 77 and 86 embed multi-claim cross-references inside the claim body/preamble rather than a standard dependency clause, obscuring dependency and category and compounding F-40a-1 for claim 61 especially.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Rewrite with the full base range in the introductory dependency clause; see Prompt 37 reply F-37-4.

findings.title: Description grammatical mismatch at [0049]
findings.attack: "FIGS. 13B is" pairs a plural article with a single figure reference and singular verb.

findings.title: EPO two-part claim form not used
findings.attack: Claims 1 and 3 are single-part form throughout; Rule 43(1) EPC contemplates a preamble/characterising-portion split, though single-part form is commonly accepted at filing.
findings.least_narrowing_action: No correction needed at filing; prepare a two-part fallback of claim 1 against US4044791A/US3473561A for use if the EPO examiner requests it.

assumptions.text: A1. Default jurisdictions are US, EPO and UK per the matter's standing default; no matter.json override was supplied among this task's inputs.
A2. 37 CFR 1.75(c) and the absence of an equivalent EPO/UK prohibition are treated as common general knowledge of patent-office practice.
A3. "Cannot assess" is used for requirements dependent on artefacts not yet produced in this run (drawings, abstract).

open_questions.text: Q1. Whether two-part EPO claim form is expected now or deferred to examination is a filing-strategy question for counsel.
Q2. Whether an abstract will be produced before this package is treated as complete for a formal filing check.
